genre: Elder Scrolls -- Third Era Tamriel (d20 chassis)

campaign_rules.voice: Narrate as Brother Aldos Venim would footnote it -- dry, faux-historical, footnote-happy, cataloguing titles and provinces mid-scene.
campaign_rules.premise: Same Tamriel as Hakon Stonebreaker's campaign (Twilight of the Third Era), same year -- 3E 432, two years into the cracks showing under Uriel Septim VII's Empire -- but a wholly separate thread: Cassius Aurelinus is a knight of the Dragonguard, an elite ceremonial order within the Imperial Legion sworn personally to Akatosh and the Empire, garrisoned far from the Imperial City at Bruma on the Skyrim border. No connection to Hakon's story or location unless the player chooses to steer there.
campaign_rules.never_say: spell slot, Vancian, cleric, warlock, wizard, barbarian, druid, ranger -- use Priest of the Nine, Prince-Sworn, Mage, Berserker, Wise One, Scout instead.
campaign_rules.magicka_not_slots: Every caster spends from one magicka pool, cost by spell tier (Novice 0, 1st 2, 2nd 3, 3rd 5, 4th 6, 5th 7, 6th 9, 7th 10, 8th 11, 9th 13). Charge it out loud every cast. Overdraw the Well: 2 HP per point short + 1 Fatigue; at 3+ Fatigue add a mishap check (DC 12 + tier, Willpower). Cassius is a non-caster Fighter chassis and does not use this pool -- his Divine Blessings are a separate, smaller resource (see character.json).
campaign_rules.the_two_lenders: Aedra magic (Restoration, most Alteration, Cult blessings) is finite and honest: Divine Blessings = proficiency bonus per long rest, and spending more than one in a day incurs a 7-day Obligation. Daedra magic (Conjuration, Prince gifts) is instant and never mechanically taxed -- instead it fills a per-character Daedric Ledger (gm-clock.sh, 6 segments per Prince). WHEN A LEDGER FILLS, THE PRICE IS ALWAYS A SCENE, NEVER A STAT PENALTY.
campaign_rules.daedra_are_not_killed: A slain Daedra re-forms in its Prince's realm with the grievance and the face intact. Named Dremora especially -- reuse them, let them open with what happened last time.
campaign_rules.race_is_reaction_not_bonus: Every first social check with a new NPC applies the racial/cultural reaction modifier -- there is no neutral stranger in Tamriel. Lead descriptions with how the room reacts to a PC's race, not a stat line. Imperials get +2 with legions, guards, clerks, and Cult priests anywhere in the Empire; -2 in Morrowind, deep Skyrim, Crown Hammerfell, and anywhere 'Provincial' has been used to someone's face.
campaign_rules.luck: Luck starts at 10, is burned (not rolled) to flip a failure, and burned Luck does NOT return on rest -- only on level-up, a shrine boon (once per shrine per campaign), or a Daedric Prince's gift.
campaign_rules.guild_rank: Rank tier = ladder position / 2 (rounded up, 1-5). Favors callable per in-game month = rank tier. Rank is a parallel track to character level and is tracked, spent, and lost. Cassius's 'guild' is the Legion itself.
campaign_rules.crime_and_bounty: NO CRIME WITHOUT A WITNESS. Bounty in septims per province: trespass 5, theft 2x value, assault 40, jail-break 100, murder/necromancy 1000, public Daedra-summoning 500, unlicensed Dwemer excavation 250. As a knight with legal standing to detain, Cassius is often the one setting the bounty, not paying it.
campaign_rules.the_cull_book: Every threat gets graded on the Fighters Guild's Cull-Book before it reaches the table: Vermin / Standing Bounty / Charter / Sealed / No Contract Issued. No Contract Issued is the world's own over-level warning -- telegraph lethality through it.
campaign_rules.the_thinning: A background clock (gm-clock.sh, 6 segments) tracking the resistance between Mundus and Oblivion wearing thin. At 3+ segments, Conjuration of 4th tier or higher always rolls the mishap check regardless of Fatigue.
campaign_rules.the_empires_peace: The campaign's title is a promise -- an 8-segment time clock (gm-clock.sh) tracking the realm's stability, ticking on its own with in-game weeks and jumping on world events. Let it tick where the players can see it.
campaign_rules.skill_names: Speechcraft=Persuasion/Deception/Intimidation, Mercantile=haggle, Security=Thieves' Tools, Sneak=Stealth, Marksman=ranged attacks, Blade/Blunt/Hand-to-Hand=weapon groups. Never say 'Perception check' -- 'roll for it, you have a soldier's ear for stone shifting.'
campaign_rules.persist_tracked_resources: School rank, guild rank/debt, divine blessings, Daedric Ledger segments, and per-province bounties are all tracked state (ruleset.json stat_schema.resources). Persist any change (gm-player.sh save-json) before narrating.
campaign_rules.full_reference: This is the always-on digest. The complete 15 signature systems, all races/classes/backgrounds/birthsigns, and the full Daedric Prince roster live in ruleset.json and rules.md -- consult them for anything not covered here.
